questions.question: In a certain code, CODE is written as 900. How will RACE be written in that code?
questions.solution:
Logic for CODE is,

C × O × D × E = 3 × 15 × 4 × 5 = 900

Similarly,

R × A × C × E = 18 × 1 × 3 × 5 = **270**.

Hence, code for RACE is **270**.

questions.question:
What will come in place of the blank in the given series?

4, 12, 36, 108, 324, ________, 2916
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

Each number is multiplied by 3 to get the next number in series.

4 × 3 = 12

12 × 3 = 36

36 × 3 = 108

108 × 3 = 324

324 × 3 = **972**

972 × 3 = 2916

Hence, the missing term in the series in **972**.

questions.question: What day did 6th August 1987 fall on?
questions.solution:
To determine the day of the week on 6th August 1987, we use the following method:

 
• 1987 = 1600 + 300 years (1601 to 1900) + 86 years (1901 to 1986) + year 1987
 
• No. of odd days from 1601 to 1900 = 1 odd day (5 odd days in every 100 years)
 
• The total number of odd days from 1901 to 1986 = 21 leap years + 65 ordinary years = 42 + 65 = 107 odd days = 2 odd days.
 
• In 1600 years, odd days = 0
 
• So total in 1986 years = 0 + 1 + 2 = 3 odd days 

 
 

 
 
Month (1987)

 
 
 
No. of odd days = no. of days in the month (mod 7)

• In 1987, the no. of days up to 6 August = 31(Jan) + 28 (Feb) + 31(Mar) + 30(Apr) + 31(May) + 30(June) + 31(July) + 6 days (Aug) = 218/7 = 1 odd days. 

Therefore, total no. of odd days up to 6th August 1987 = 3 + 1 = 4

Now, if the remainder (the total no. of odd days) is as follows, then it corresponds to the following day:

• We have remainder 4 which corresponds to Thursday.

Hence, on 6th August 1987, it was a Thursday.

questions.question: Two inlet pipes A and E can fill an empty cistern in 12 minutes and 36 minutes respectively. Both the pipes A and E are opened together and after some time pipe, A is closed. Thus it takes 20 minutes to completely fill the tank, then for how many minutes pipe A was open?
questions.solution:
Part of cistern filled by pipe A in 1 min. = 1/12

Part of cistern filled by pipe E in 1 min. = 1/36

Let the pipe A was open for ‘x’ min.

∵ Pipe E was open for 20 min.,

⇒ Total work done = (x × 1/12) + (20 × 1/36) = 1

⇒ x/12 = 4/9

⇒ x = 48/9 min. = 16/3 min.

∴ The pipe A was open for 5(1)/(3) minutes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e228480450486c059aaa2f8154f86503a89ba29cacd14c5f2154d7d46bc14930.png] 

Formula Used:

Efficiency × Time taken = Total capacity of tank

Total capacity of cistern = LCM of time taken

Calculation:

Capacity of a tank = LCM of 12 and 36

⇒ Capacity of a tank = 36 units

Efficiency of A,

⇒ 36/12 = 3 units per minute

Efficiency of E,

⇒ 36/36 = 1 units per min.

According to the condition, E worked till the work gets completed

⇒ E worked for 20 minutes

Units filled by E,

⇒ 1 × 20 = 20 units filled by E

Remaining units filled by A,

⇒ Remaining units = 36 – 20 = 16 units

To fill 16 units, A will take,

⇒ 16/3 = 5(1)/(3)

Time taken by trains to cross each other = Sum of lengths of trains/Their relative speed

⇒ Time taken by trains to cross each other = (140 + 100)/20 = 12 sec.

∴ The trains will completely cross each other in 12 seconds

questions.question: Harish switched on a bulb at 01∶23∶44 hours and switched it off on the same day at 11∶14∶38 hours. For how long was the bulb in switched-on mode?
questions.solution:

We know 1 hour = 60 mins and 1 min = 60 secs

⇒ 11 hours 14 mins 38 secs = 11 hours 13 mins 60 + 38 secs = 11 hours 13 mins 98 secs

Again, 11 hours 13 mins 98 secs = 10 hours 60 + 13 mins 98 secs = 10 hours 73 mins 98 secs

 10 ∶ 73 ∶ 98

__ - 01 ∶ 23 ∶ 44__

 09 ∶ 50 ∶ 54

∴ The correct answer is 09 hours 50 mins 54 secs.

questions.question:
**Select the correct passive form of the given sentence.**

The Delhi Government recently laid the foundation stone for the redevelopment project for Chandni Chowk.

options.text: The redevelopment project for the foundation stone for Chandni chowk was recently laid by the Delhi Government.
The foundation stone for the redevelopment project for Chandni Chowk has recently been laid by the Delhi Government.
The foundation stone for the redevelopment project for Chandni Chowk is recently being laid by the Delhi Government.
The foundation stone for the redevelopment project for Chandni Chowk was recently laid by the Delhi Government.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**The foundation stone for the redevelopment project for Chandni Chowk was recently laid by the Delhi Government.**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question we have to change it into Passive Voice. 
 
• The structure of the given sentence as follows:
 
 
• Subject + V2+ Object. (Active Voice)
 
• Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
 
 
 
• The subject of the given sentence is '**The Delhi Government**'.​​
 
• The object of the given sentence is '**the foundation stone for the redevelopment project for Chandni Chowk**'. 
 
• The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
 
• And 'laid' will be changed into 'was recently laid'. 
 
• Lastly, the 'by' preposition will be added. 
 
• Therefore, as per the points mentioned above, we find that the correct answer is Option 4.

 ​

Correct Sentence:__ *The foundation stone for the redevelopment project for Chandni Chowk was recently laid by the Delhi Government.*

* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__***

 
• **Adverb of frequency (laid) **always comes between the auxiliary verb and the main verb.* *

4c:T

questions.question:
In the following question, a sentence has been given in Active/Passive Voice. Out of the four alternatives suggested, select the one which best expresses the same sentence in Passive/Active Voice.

questions.question:
**Given below are six sentences, four of which, are jumbled. Pick the option that gives the correct order.**

Sentence 1. At least 370 residents of the islands of Java and Sumatra were killed on Saturday when a sudden tsunami struck the coastline.

P. While Indonesia has tsunami-detection buoys positioned off its coastlines, they have not functioned for six years.

Q. An eruption of the volcano Anak Krakatau set off an underwater landslide at 2130 hours local time Saturday, triggering a giant tsunami.

R. But given the landslide’s proximity to inhabited areas, an early-warning system may not have affected the outcome, according to experts.

S. Anak Krakatau, is located at the entrance to the Sunda Strait, about 20 nm from the nearest populated shores.

Sentence 6. In addition to the rising death toll, more than 1450 were injured in the disaster, and another 130 remain missing.
questions.solution:
The first sentence introduces the main topic of the tsunami, and its consequences.

**The sentence that most logically follows sentence 1 should be Q**, since it expands on the topic of the tsunami by describing why and how it was triggered.

**The next sentence should be S** since it expands upon the topic of Anak Krakatau, mentioned previously in sentence Q.

Out of the two remaining sentences, the sentence that comes first must be P since sentence R directly references and expands upon the tsunami-detection system first introduced only in P.

Hence, the correct order should be: **QSPR**.

Hence, **option 2 is correct.**

• Change the verb inside the quotation marks from past tense to past perfect tense.
 
• Use pronouns appropriately: ‘I’ turns to ‘he’.
 
• The sentence is a statement, not a question. Hence, option 4 is incorrect.

The only sentence that follows these rules is **sentence 2.**

Hence, **option 2 is correct.**

questions.question:

• The **next sentence should be S** since it directly follows the topic of ‘beds’ introduced in sentence Q.
 
• Similarly, the **next sentence should be R** since it talks about ‘respirators’ referring to the ‘machinery’ mentioned in sentence S.
 
• The n**ext sentence will obviously be P**.
